# Path scenes for the golden images (src/draw/paths_golden.zig draws them, make.py makes the
# references). `scene NAME W H` starts a canvas; `fill RULE RRGGBBAA` starts a shape filled
# under RULE (nonzero, even_odd); then path verbs, SVG letters, absolute coordinates:
# M x y, L x y, Q cx cy x y, C c0x c0y c1x c1y x y, Z.

scene lines 48 48
fill nonzero ffffffff
M 3.3 4.1
L 21.7 6.2
L 9.4 22.8
Z
fill nonzero ff8040ff
M 33.5 18.6
L 41.494 43.203
L 20.566 27.997
L 46.434 27.997
L 25.506 43.203
Z
fill even_odd 60c0ffc0
M 14.2 23.4
L 20.842 43.842
L 3.453 31.208
L 24.947 31.208
L 7.558 43.842
Z

scene quads 48 48
fill nonzero ffffffff
M 6.2 40.5
Q 8 6 41.3 7.4
Q 38 41 6.2 40.5
Z
fill nonzero 202020ff
M 14.5 30.25
Q 24 24 33 15.5
Q 20 18 14.5 30.25
Z

scene cubics 48 48
fill nonzero ff4060ff
M 24 41.3
C 4 28 6.5 8 24 16.5
C 41.5 8 44 28 24 41.3
Z
fill nonzero ffffff80
M 2.5 45.5
C 15 30 33 60 45.5 2.5
L 45.5 45.5
Z

scene rules 64 32

C 2.1 11.009 6.309 6.8 11.5 6.8
C 16.691 6.8 20.9 11.009 20.9 16.2
Z
M 28.4 15.7
C 28.4 20.174 24.774 23.8 20.3 23.8
C 15.826 23.8 12.2 20.174 12.2 15.7
C 12.2 11.226 15.826 7.6 20.3 7.6
C 24.774 7.6 28.4 11.226 28.4 15.7
Z
fill even_odd ffffffff
M 52.9 16.2
C 52.9 21.391 48.691 25.6 43.5 25.6
C 38.309 25.6 34.1 21.391 34.1 16.2
C 34.1 11.009 38.309 6.8 43.5 6.8
C 48.691 6.8 52.9 11.009 52.9 16.2
Z
M 60.4 15.7
C 60.4 20.174 56.774 23.8 52.3 23.8
